bio.text: Zack Mullock is the Democratic nominee for New Jersey's 2nd Congressional District in the November 2026 general election, against Rep. Jeff Van Drew.
He won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary over three other candidates.
He has been mayor of Cape May since 2021 and is a lifelong Cape May resident, according to WHYY.
